description: Identified, evaluated and led a bi-County steering committee in all technical aspect in an RFP release and selection process.
Managed a project support team including administrators, help desk staff and trainers.
Acted as liaison between vendors, operation staff and the CFO for all major projects on time and on budget.
Managed the overall management, infrastructure and strategic planning of our National point of sale network at 100+ retail locations and 5 distribution centers.

education.institution: California State University, Mihaylo College of Business and Economics

matchmaking_summary: As a seasoned Director of Information Technology with over a decade in the field, I have led and managed large-scale IT operations effectively. My expertise spans across cloud environments design & implementation, network design & implementation (VOIP), cyber security (NIST HITRUST/HIPAA), project management, technical support management, and budget management. With a strong focus on emerging technologies like SaaS and hybrid cloud environment deployment in 2008, I have consistently demonstrated foresight and financial prudence. My leadership has been instrumental in shaping the IT strategy and infrastructure for multiple organizations, fostering strategic partnerships to drive technological advancements.
